Škoda Media Room, the app used by journalists, media representatives, and fans of the brand worldwide, has recently been given a complete overhaul. Most tellingly, the app features an entirely new look aligned with Škoda Auto’s updated corporate identity.

All the enhancements made to Škoda Media Room ensure that it remains a mobile gateway to the latest information from the world of Škoda. The latest press releases, Škoda-themed Stories and insightful information about Škoda Auto, including financial results and annual reports, continue to be available, as do full model descriptions, technical data, images and videos. The app is also a convenient one-stop shop for the latest Škoda social media posts.
